title: Disentangling Spurious Correlations in Vision-Language-Action Models via Predicting Domain-Invariant Latent Lookahead
abstract: arXiv:2609.37165v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models remain brittle under visual distribution shifts, often relying on spurious correlations tied to domain-specific factors rather than task-relevant structure. We propose Domain-Invariant Latent Lookahead (DILL), a representation-learning framework that mitigates shortcut learning in VLA policies. Our key idea is to supervise policies with domain-invariant future latents learned from domain-transformed trajectory data. A Task-Domain Encoder is trained with contrastive objectives and Gaussian disentanglement regularization to separate task-relevant structure from domain-specific visual variation. The learned encoder then provides future latents for VLA policy learning through lookahead prediction and domain disentanglement, encouraging the policy to focus on task-relevant structure rather than incidental visual factors. translated_title: 通过预测域不变潜在前瞻来解耦视觉-语言-动作模型中的虚假相关性
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在视觉分布偏移下仍然脆弱，往往依赖于与特定领域因素绑定的虚假相关性，而非与任务相关的结构。我们提出了域不变潜在前瞻（DILL），这是一个用于缓解VLA策略中捷径学习的表示学习框架。我们的核心思想是使用从域变换轨迹数据中学到的域不变未来潜在表示来监督策略。任务-域编码器通过对比目标和Gaussian解耦正则化进行训练，以将任务相关结构与特定领域的视觉变化分离开来。学习到的编码器随后通过前瞻预测和域解耦为VLA策略学习提供未来潜在表示，鼓励策略关注任务相关的结构而非偶然的视觉因素。反事实任务视角评估表明，DILL减少了对捷径的依赖，同时
tldr: 提出DILL表示学习框架，通过从域变换轨迹数据中学习域不变的未来潜在表示来监督VLA策略，将任务相关结构与领域特定视觉因素解耦，从而减少视觉分布偏移下的捷径学习和虚假相关性依赖。
